what: The declared widened band population: the block-fold measurement's six (file, language) cells re-measured with the mapped set, streams, seeds, machinery, restarts, sweep cap, plants, floors, block-fold split and leave-one-out table carried forward unchanged, and each cell's band extended with the declared widened members, so the real is priced above a band of seven members per english cell and eight per latin cell. The bridge gate re-derived the frozen block-fold artifact's first cell through the extended member list before the widened cells ran. The declared truthful question: does the real's held-out score-half value still stand above the band as the band's population grows. No mapping is published; nothing here is a reading.

declared.split_rule: the counted pairs of each side, in stream order, split into contiguous blocks at the midpoint: the first floor(N/2) pairs the climb half the machinery may search, the remaining pairs the score half it may never touch; for an odd count the climb half takes the smaller first block; the halves share no counted pair and every identity anchor's halves fold by the same rule; deterministic, consuming no seed
declared.loo_rule: the shape measurement's leave-one-out table carried forward unchanged: the inherited add-one form is log((n_ab + 1) / (N + 729)) with N the reference stream's total counted pairs; every pair type (a, b) present in the reference pair table is scored with one occurrence of (a, b) removed from the reference counts, log(n_ab / (N + 728)), and a type with no counted occurrence keeps the inherited add-one entry log(1 / (N + 729)); the letter marginals and rank initialisation unchanged, the matrix arithmetic needing no re-derivation as the shape measurement declared
declared.measured_facts_rule: the mapped set, streams, seeds, machinery, restarts, sweep cap, plants, floors and split are the held-out screen's and block-fold measurement's declarations carried unchanged; the real, plants, floors and standing band members are byte-identical replays of the frozen block-fold artifact's declared draws and only the band's population changes; each member records draws_climb_exact, its five climb-half totals at full precision; each side's exact full-data side call is recorded beside its held-out value for attribution only
declared.machinery_rule: unchanged from the held-out screen: the exact greedy reassignment climb on the climb half, exact pricing on the score half, restart 0 the rank initialisation from the climb half, restarts 1 onward the seeded permutations of the 27 letter tokens under the wrap rule, the best restart the best exact climb-half total with ties to the first; no assignment is stored
declared.seed_sharing: no new seed kinds are consumed: the real, plants, floors and standing members replay the block-fold measurement's declared draws from the declared kinds at the declared positions, and the widened members consume the declared cross kinds at seed positions beyond every earlier measurement's declared positions (english 3 to 6, latin 4 to 7), consuming none of any other module's declared draws
declared.bridge_gate: before the widened cells run, the widened instrument's full first cell (ZL english: the real, its five plants, its five floors and its three standing band members) is computed through this measurement's code with the extended member list supplied and compared field for field against the frozen block-fold artifact's own first cell; any divergence aborts with nothing written
declared.corpus_source_rule: the widened members are fetched from the standing members' declared source in the same plain text form; the fetch was first verified byte-identical by refetching the standing english2 file and matching its recorded sha256, and each widened member's file is stored raw under engine/data with its Gutenberg markers and processed by the standing declared processing (the body extracted between the markers, the ligatures joined, NFD plus casefold, letters to 0 to 25 and non-letter runs to the single boundary token), with the sha256 recorded below
declared.corpus_rule: widened members are modern printed prose under the declared corpus rules: marker spans keeping only transcriber-note scale english scaffolding (the standing members' scale is 0 to 52 english common-word hits), with candidates whose span interleaves english translations, glossed school notes or collation apparatus through the body, or whose english scaffolding runs beyond that standing scale, rejected with cause as family 4 rejected its school editions and glossed readers

declared.band_record_rule: membership, selection, ties and spreads are declared unchanged from the held-out screen (a member's band value the held-out value of the draw whose exact climb-half total is best, strict beyond 1e-12, ties to the first draw); each member records draws_climb_exact, its five climb-half totals at full precision, so the declared selection is re-derivable from the stored artifact; extended membership unconditional: every widened member enters the band unconditionally and no convergence criterion is applied to any member
declared.verdict_rule: unchanged from the held-out screen and applied to the block-fold-scale numbers: the real held-out at or above the smallest member band value is consistent-with-substitution, at or below the largest floor's held-out value is not-consistent, strictly between is below-held-band; the strings describe consistency under this artifact's declared split and do not restate the parity split's verdicts
declared.margin_rule: the margin is computed from the stored rounded values: the real held-out mean minus the smallest member band value, rounded to four decimals
declared.exclusion_rule: the family's declared exclusion format is not re-scoped by this artifact: it keys to the declared 36-slot class under the inherited add-one form exactly as the held-out screen declared it, so a widened-band verdict is corpus-breadth evidence and the block-fold measurement's verdicts stand untouched by this artifact's numbers
declared.truthful_question: declared in advance: does the real's held-out score-half value still stand above the band as the band's population grows beyond the standing members - a yes extends the separation across the corpus breadth, a no records that the margin rode the band's small population
